scientific_findings.title: Flammability, thermal and physical-mechanical properties of cationic polymer/montmorillonite composite on cotton fabric
Cotton fabric coated with intumescent formulation containing polymers and inorganic additives: Thermal and flammability behaviour

verification_limit:
Two complete nine-page original papers provide 15 new, source-confirmed cotton-fabric sample states and 15 TG condition records. Neither paper contributes evidence upgrades or completions of existing samples.

DOI 10.1016/j.compositesb.2015.03.061 contributes five initial 259 g/m² cotton-fabric states. Table 2 TG and Table 3 LOI (p. 334) match the control and PDMDAAC-AGE/MMT finishes. TG uses nitrogen, 10 °C/min, 20–600 °C and 60 mL/min in open alumina pans. T5 denotes 5% mass loss; the final residual mass is explicitly at 590 °C. Residue at each sample's DTG peak remains a separate measurement. The 2% and 4% MMT formulations have LOI but no corresponding tabulated TG and remain held. Nominal reaction-feed percentages and wet pickup are not converted into retained coating fractions.

DOI 10.1007/s12221-014-2495-7 contributes ten initial coated-cotton states, matched through Table 1 recipes, Table 2 TG (p. 2497) and Table 4 LOI (p. 2501). Ordinary TG uses static air, 10 °C/min and 40–700 °C. Nitrogen, 50 mL/min, 4–8 mg and an aluminium pan describe DSC and are not assigned to TG. T10 and T50 denote explicitly defined mass-loss thresholds. Nine treated fabrics have separately reported residual masses at 600 and 700 °C. The control's single 0.3% entry under a combined 600/700 heading remains raw and temperature-unbound; its independently reported T10, T50 and DTG values still support the pair. The control's two DTG peaks are retained; treated samples have only the peaks actually tabulated. Conflicting substrate areal-density statements and unknown final add-on, measurement replication and conditioning remain unresolved rather than guessed. A general control-degradation statement cites an earlier paper without declaring Table 2 a reprint; numerical profiles and source aliases show no matching existing state. Source/sample counts do not claim independent experimental replicates.

Both TG and LOI refer to the same initial textile cloth and finish. Preparation rinsing is not a durability-wash state. MCC, DSC, furnace-char and fire-test residues are not substituted for TG, and no curves were estimated. The complete review covers 18 primary pages, seven tables, 18 figure captions and three scheme captions. Eighty-one source checks and three scientific boundary regressions passed. The refreshed audit compares full and reduced temperature-bound profiles, including rounding risks, across existing and staged evidence: 179 comparisons, zero hits, zero unresolved accepted matches. Seventeen factual rows comprise 15 admitted pairs and two LOI-only holds, with one held residual-temperature metric. All 1,829 existing TG records and their fields are preserved. The broad master changes from 1,430/1,829 to 1,445/1,844 sample states/TG records; these broad totals are not the verified textile-only total. The textile-only target is 3,000 states and its global scope audit is pending. Original files, full texts and local paths remain local.
